cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 88% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.38% · WTI +1.01% · Brent +0.98% · NatGas +1.94%. 88% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +5.62%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.62%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.13%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +6.90%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +6.90%, BE +6.86%, PWR +6.58%, OKLO +6.42%, VRT +6.29%. Laggards: DUK -0.97%, NEE -0.60%, ETR -0.56%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
